canonical_title: UAE revises 5GW AI campus into distributed hardened data-center network
aliases: UAE-US AI Campus distributed data centers
treatment: Repeat only for a finalized revised masterplan, material capacity/timeline change, confirmed site distribution, new security architecture, or partner commitment change.
known_facts: Reuters reported that the UAE is revising the planned 5GW AI campus from a single roughly 10-square-mile Abu Dhabi campus toward a network of data centers distributed across the UAE.
Officials are considering underground construction, blast-resistant concrete, backup power and cooling, electronic jamming, and drone/missile air defenses.
The first $30 billion 1GW Stargate UAE phase is expected to continue, with the first 200MW still due online in 2026, although protective modifications are being considered.
G42 said work is progressing as planned and that project specifics remain under continuous review.
reinclude_only_if: The UAE or G42 publishes the finalized revised masterplan.
The 5GW target, first-phase 1GW target, or 2026 200MW commissioning schedule changes materially.
Specific new sites, underground/mountain facilities, or air-defense/security requirements are officially confirmed.
OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco, or SoftBank materially changes its role or commitment.
notes: Reuters exclusive based on six people familiar with the deliberations; revised masterplan was not yet finalized.
